title: No-Guts Chicken Roast
method: Spatchcock chicken by cutting out the backbone with kitchen scissors and flattening.
Separate skin from meat over breasts and legs using fingers.
Finely chop fresh rosemary, oregano, and sage; incorporate into softened butter.
Distribute herb butter evenly underneath chicken skin across breasts and thighs.
Roast at 190°C for 60-80 mins until skin is deeply golden and juices run clear, basting every 20 mins.
